get_config: get the value of a named TF2JAX configuration parameter like strict_shape_check
update_config: update a TF2JAX configuration parameter with a new boolean or string value
override_config: temporarily override a single TF2JAX config parameter within a context manager
copy_config: create a deep copy of the entire TF2JAX configuration dictionary
override_configs: temporarily override multiple TF2JAX config parameters within a context manager
